model.description: Fixed-denominator fidelity loss for the T3 Code Web to Lynx-for-Web to Lynxtron Native port.

points.label: First archived matched geometry
points.narrative: New Thread exposed a 216px focal geometry miss and complete content drift; Settings and the populated Sidebar were already structurally close.

points.label: Exact-owned Native readiness
points.narrative: Three isolated starts proved the main-owned transport, advancing sequence, canonical thread/model identity, and zero renderer errors.

points.label: Seven-state Browser matrix
points.narrative: The first dual-renderer matrix proved identity and readiness across 14 cells. It also exposed that green harness geometry baselines were not visual parity.

points.label: 39-state strict evidence matrix
points.narrative: Plan 11C expanded the denominator to 39 product states. Browser content coverage became broad, while Native evidence remained intentionally sparse and R5/R10 blockers stayed explicit.

points.label: First Native pixel baseline
points.narrative: A real Web/Native comparison measured 4.467 MAE and 5.86% significant-pixel share across the full 1280×820 frame.

points.label: Masked pixel residual convergence
points.narrative: After deterministic timer masking, full-frame residual fell to 1.1009 MAE and 1.2763% significant pixels; Composer, Sidebar, Header, and Transcript regions became independently measurable.

points.label: Four-state review interaction matrix
points.narrative: Four combinations of Sidebar and changed-files state passed exact-owned Native interaction and geometry checks; card-region SSIM improved from 0.7492 to 0.8758.

points.label: Model Picker fidelity closeout
points.narrative: Browser geometry reached zero panel delta; Native proved main transport, exact 360×346 panel geometry, real-tap dismissal, scrolling, search, favorites, and provider/model selection. Selected-state pixels remained explicitly pending.

points.label: Evidence archaeology reset
points.narrative: The product did not regress. Archaeology removed stale pixels and demoted pre-final5 claims, so current-head evidence confidence falls while historical observed residual remains intact.

attribution.reason: This loss decrease comes from the first current-head Browser measurement after the archaeology reset, not from a measured product change between commits.

points.label: Current-head docked Composer browser pair
points.narrative: The isolated Web/Lynx pair matched six Composer geometry anchors, controls, context labels, semantic state, and clean readiness. Placeholder copy and material pixels remain visibly different; interaction and Native claims remain unmeasured.

attribution.reason: A before/after Browser pair measures one working-tree product change: Web and Lynx now consume the same session-phase placeholder projection.

points.label: Docked Composer placeholder parity
points.narrative: A shared session-phase placeholder projection removed the only measured Composer content mismatch. All nine content anchors now match, geometry remains exact, and Composer/context SSIM improves from 0.894106 to 0.914911. Native and interaction claims remain unmeasured.

attribution.reason: A before/after Native interaction investigation isolated and removed the Sidebar-only width transition while retaining the same scope, weights, and pointer sample sequence.

points.label: Native Sidebar resize cursor tracking
points.narrative: A new interaction scope records the Native Sidebar resize. The product previously applied every pointer sample through a 200ms width transition, visibly trailing the cursor. During drag the transition is now disabled, and ten retained geometry samples in each direction match cursor-derived width with 0px maximum error. Lynx-for-Web remains unmeasured for interaction and retains unknown loss.

attribution.reason: Classification only: historical runtime evidence cannot be promoted to a current-head product residual without matching final5 captures.

points.label: Review diff current-head evidence blocker
points.narrative: No product loss is recorded. The apparent review-diff residual of 1.0 comes from a historical R10 runtimeBlocked gate while the final5 manifest still marks Web, Lynx-for-Web, and Native review evidence pending. This is a capture/evidence mismatch and remains outside product-loss attribution until one canonical snapshot is captured on all required clients.

attribution.reason: Current-head canonical captures supersede stale runtime-blocker evidence without attributing the evidence correction to a product code change.

points.label: Current-head Hero and Sendable Composer pair
points.narrative: Canonical Web and Lynx-for-Web captures share one server, snapshot, new-thread route, dark theme, density, project, and 1280x820 viewport. Hero and Sendable content, geometry, controls, context labels, input, and primary action match. The old 62.64% residual was historical runtime-blocker evidence plus a placeholder extractor mismatch; current measurable product loss is material pixels.

attribution.reason: One CSS-only product change was measured against the same canonical Hero snapshot and viewport before and after.

points.label: Hero Composer footer material parity
points.narrative: Lynx removed its footer-only vertical offset and fixed control widths, then aligned horizontal padding and transparent border box sizing with Web. Footer SSIM improves from 0.746677 to 0.843791 and Composer-region SSIM improves from 0.901043 to 0.923045.

points.label: Lifecycle reconnecting parity
points.narrative: A corrected fault harness waits for Lynx branch discovery before terminating the owned server, separating early-fault noise from product loss. On the stable parent commit, content and semantic Composer pixels already match, but Lynx alone renders the lifecycle banner above the draft hero and shifts the Composer 31px downward. The product fix suppresses that separate hero banner and retains the last known model presentation while unavailable. The after capture passes every gate with 24 zero-delta geometry anchors and improves full-frame SSIM from 0.866145 to 0.914674. Native recovery and reconnect interaction remain unmeasured.

referenceSystem.adaptation: T3 adds a fixed denominator, explicit evidence confidence, and a time/commit loss ledger.

policy: Evidence dates and code commits are separate fields.
Unknown cells retain maximum conservative loss.
Browser evidence never satisfies Native-only interaction or runtime cells.
Superseding stale pixels reduces confidence without rewriting historical product residual.
